name: delete-comment
description: Purge comments from a codebase: classify each as tautology, stale, excuse, or decision record; delete them, file issues for excuses, and move decisions into ADRs or tests; then measure the lines removed. Keeps tool directives and license notices, and deletes only behind a code-token check. Use when asked to delete or audit every comment in a codebase or directory, move comment rationale into ADRs, or estimate the lines saved.
